messages:
Sam: CI alert - nightly turned red on shard 13 around 07:00 UTC. Integration failures touching auth + streaming + toolcall intermittently. 403s from tool-proxy then a schema mismatch. cc @Priya @Marco

Priya: looking now. any link to the failing job? :eyes:

Sam: https://ci.internal/runs/1709129999/shard-13 (rerun button on infra-bot failed earlier)

Marco: grabbing logs, quick paste:
```
E 403 Forbidden POST /tool-proxy/exec
  at proxy.go:142
  caused_by: auth: token expired
... then
E schema mismatch: expected {result,meta} got {status,error}
```

Elena: token expired sounds like the session-rotate that rolled at ~06:55. did the harness pick up the new k8s secret? @infra-bot did session-rotate run? :thinking:

infra-bot: session-rotate cronjob completed at 06:58 UTC on k8s-cluster-3. No throttles reported. Re-run link: https://ci.internal/retry/1709129999/shard-13

Priya: can someone try a targeted rerun with auth debug logs attached? i want `DEBUG_AUTH=true` in env.

Sam: i'm rerunning with `DEBUG_AUTH=true` and `TEST_SHARD=13` now. adding `--rerun-id=triage-1709129999` for correlation.

Marco: FYI did a quick bisect locally: `git bisect start HEAD HEAD~40` narrowed to commit `a3f9b2d` which touched toolcall auth header handling. not 100% repro yet but suspicious.

Priya: good find. can you paste the minimal repro so i can run smoke with simulated token rotation?

Marco: local repro command i used:
```
TEST_SHARD=13 DEBUG_AUTH=true ./dev/integ/run_smoke.sh --target toolcall --commit a3f9b2d
```
It errored with same 403 + schema mismatch.

Elena: if a3f9b2d changed header ordering, proxy might reject. mitigation for tonight: pin shard 13 to fallback proxy route (no auth) in pipeline config while we patch. prefer that to disabling whole suite.

Oncall: agreement to pin fallback for shard 13 for tonight, will open pipeline change and revert once fixed. i'll own the config change. :white_check_mark:

Sam: priya/marco can you collaborate on a minimal fix for header generation and add a regression test? i'll queue a canary on dedicated infra before merge.

Priya: creating branch `fix/tool-auth-header-order` and drafting PR, tagging Marco for review.

Marco: reviewing now, attaching bisect notes and the local repro command to the PR.

infra-bot: rerun completed: job green on rerun with DEBUG_AUTH=true but only because the test fell back to unsecured test route. baseline rerun without DEBUG still fails.

Sam: confirms proxy rejects current auth header ordering. triage complete, moving to PR. will report canary result here. :pray:

Oncall: leaving pipeline pin in place for 12h, reminder set to revert in 11h. anyone object?

Elena: no objections. please add short note to #postmortems if nightly metrics are impacted.

Sam: will add postmortem blurb and close thread for now. updates on PR/canary in this thread.
